scope: gfx1151 Poolside Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M BF16-KV eager c=1 source-F16 attention projections

change.description: Use cache-bypassing loads for the one-pass FP16 weight streams inside the exact projection/head/KV and output-projection/add/RMSNorm decode composites. Activation loads, fixed-K ownership, F32 FMA/reduction association, BF16 boundaries, grids, launches, and resident bytes are unchanged.
change.source_premise: llama.cpp Vulkan's fast non-quant path treats decode weights as streaming traffic while preserving cache for the much smaller reused activation and attention working sets.

leaf.protocol: four natural source-F16 roles, 21 counterbalanced samples x 20 launches after 5 warmups

same_resident_gate.workload: p512/d128 eager c=1, matrix rows 2048, attention rows 128
same_resident_gate.protocol: seven counterbalanced pairs in one resident session; load excluded

trace.protocol: cache-only rocprofv3 kernel trace over natural global/SWA and K6144/K9216 fixtures; no compiler under profiler

decision: Retain as the gfx1151 default. Every natural leaf and all seven model pairs improve, exact state and resident bytes are unchanged, and cache-only tracing proves the intended production templates. Publish a tracked-clean selector-unset run before updating the canonical topline.
